title: effect/1: the Effects one Result asks for, one list for each type, so that a list's shape is the one its type needs. A type a Result may not request has no list here. The name and conclusion of a check run, the commit a review is on, the branches a draft is opened between, its closing line and the actor are apply's, never the Result's.

push_commits.description: A Role's push: the bundle its Run handed over, a patch as git diff writes it, by the artifact it was handed over in and its digest. The patch's text is the model's to write, under patch.body. The bundle names the bytes handed over, and its digest is of those bytes. For a push with its patch they are to be that text as UTF-8, nothing added or taken away: filling the bundle so is the Harness's (issue 880). The text is at most 200,000 characters: the one bound on it, stated here and nowhere else. The branch it lands on, and the commit it lands on top of, are apply's, never the Result's; apply refuses one that touches a protected path or a model Lens's input on the base's list before it mints any token (issue 139). One to a Result. No Role permits it yet.

open_pull_request.$comment: The bounds are GitHub's, and stated here and nowhere else, as patch.body's is: a guard writes no number. GitHub refuses a pull request whose title is over 256 characters, or whose body is over 65,536. The title is the model's alone, so it may hold all 256. apply appends its closing line to the body, so the model's body is held to 65,000, which leaves 536 characters: far more than a line that closes one issue by its number takes. Each is counted in code points, as the validator counts them; how GitHub counts is grounded by no trial. The title holds at least one character that is not white space, by its pattern; the validator refuses any value under a pattern that ends in a line break, which no one-line title needs.
open_pull_request.description: The opening Run's draft (issue 838): its title and its body, each the model's text under a body, and nothing else. The branch it is opened from is the work branch the Decision admitted, and the branch it is opened to the default branch; the closing line, the one link in the draft, which closes exactly the Run's issue, is apply's to append to the body: each is apply's, from the Decision and the issue, never the Result's. None of what apply does with it is built yet. Once its dispatch is, apply is to write the draft after the push, so that the draft holds the commit just pushed, and to refuse, before it mints any token, a reference GitHub could read as a link, a mention or a closing keyword in either text. A Run admitted on a work branch at the commit an earlier opening Run of this issue pushed is to ask for it alone and push nothing; a work branch at any other commit is refused, and no draft is opened from it. One to a Result. No Role permits it, and it opens nothing until apply has its writer.
